dedupe_keys.name: jodhpur district drrp road network kml

description: This repository publishes one KML layer for Jodhpur District roads in Rajasthan. The README describes 2,346 road placemarks with line or multiline geometries in WGS 84 longitude and latitude. Attributes include road category, code, owner, district and block identifiers, feature ID and two length representations: Shape_Leng in degrees and Length in kilometres. The named categories include village, major district, other district, state-highway and national-highway roads. The repository presents the layer as part of a Public Works Department district regional road plan and includes a map viewer; it does not link the original government file or state a survey date. The GitHub project states MIT and is publicly accessible, but the original plan’s data rights were not independently checked. A modeller could use the geometry as a candidate regional road graph for network-flow or access analysis after checking connectivity and planning status. The README says existing and proposed roads share the layer, so it cannot be used as a verified present-day inventory without separating them. No KML feature, length value or viewer rendering was independently inspected. No directly related catalogue record was found for this district plan layer.
